# Gap

`layout/gap` &middot; section-level &middot; category: layout

## Purpose

Vertical space between sections, on a background color so it blends with the sections around it.

## Required fields

None.

## Optional fields

None.

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Medium gap on the surface color.
- **small**: Small gap. Sets `height: @spacing.sm`.
- **large**: Large gap. Sets `height: @spacing.2xl`.
- **page**: A gap on the page background color, separating two cards. Sets `background: @colors.background`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `height` | length | `"@spacing.lg"` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A section with a fixed-height spacer, honored. | Fine. | Swaps to the dark surface when on the brand surface or background color. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('layout/gap', {}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "layout/gap",
  "data": {}
}
```
